# Cornell Legal Information Institute (LII)

> > Comprehensive free legal research platform providing access to the U.S. Code, Code of Federal Regulations, Federal Register, and extensive legal commentary from Cornell Law School.

The Legal Information Institute at Cornell Law School is one of the oldest and most respected free legal research sites on the internet. It provides authoritative access to federal regulations, statutes, case law, and educational resources for legal professionals, scholars, and the public.

## Key Topics

- Code of Federal Regulations (CFR)
- Federal Register
- Electronic Code of Federal Regulations (e-CFR)
- United States Code
- Administrative Law
- Federal Regulations
- Government Publishing
- Document Filing Requirements
- Publication Requirements
- Office of the Federal Register
- Administrative Committee of the Federal Register
- Executive Orders
- Civil Procedure
- Legal Education

## Federal Regulations & CFR Access

- [Electronic Code of Federal Regulations (e-CFR): Table Of Contents](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text): Table of contents for Electronic Code of Federal Regulations (e-CFR)
- [1 CFR Part 2 - GENERAL INFORMATION](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/1/part-2): CFR Part 2 general information on Federal Register and administrative rules
- [1 CFR Part 304 - DISCLOSURE OF RECORDS OR INFORMATION](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/1/part-304): CFR Part 304 on FOIA procedures and Privacy Act records disclosure
- [1 CFR § 5.9 - Categories of documents](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/1/5.9): Federal Register document categories: rules, proposed rules, notices
- [1 CFR § 5.5 - Supplement to the Code of Federal Regulations](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/1/5.5): CFR supplement and Federal Register daily publication codification
- [1 CFR § 51.1 - Policy](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/1/51.1): CFR policy on incorporation by reference and Director approval requirements

## Federal Register Publication Requirements

- [1 CFR § 5.1 - Publication policy](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/1/5.1): Federal Register publication policy and document filing requirements
- [1 CFR § 5.2 - Documents required to be filed for public inspection and published](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/1/5.2): Federal Register filing requirements for presidential and agency documents
- [1 CFR § 5.10 - Forms of publication](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/1/5.10): Federal Register forms of publication including govinfo.gov access
- [1 CFR § 5.7 - Delivery and mailing](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/1/5.7): Federal Register delivery procedures and publication schedule requirements
- [1 CFR § 5.3 - Publication of other documents](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/1/5.3): Director of Federal Register authority for other document publication
- [1 CFR § 5.4 - Publication not authorized](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/1/5.4): Federal Register publication restrictions and prohibited documents

## Specialized Legal Topics & Resources

- [Civil Procedure Stories - Briefs & Such](https://civprostories.law.cornell.edu/): Archive of civil procedure case documents including Erie R.R. v. Tompkins
- [LII's Focus on Terrorism Law](https://www.law.cornell.edu/background/terrorism.htm): Backgrounder on terrorism law, executive orders, and post-9/11 legislation
- [LII: liibulletin-ny](https://www.law.cornell.edu/bulletin/topics.htm): Legal topics directory covering commercial law and New York law commentary

## Optional

- [Breaking Out of Legal Education's Box](https://www.law.cornell.edu/background/distance/otb): Article on legal education reform and distance learning for professionals
- [1 CFR § 11.2 - Federal Register](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/1/11.2): CFR regulation on Federal Register subscription pricing and formats
